overview: A dark, mobile-first virtual DJ controller with two decks, a central mixer, effects, sample pads and recording.
features: Two independent decks with jog wheels, BPM and time displays
Central mixer with 3-band EQ, gain, filter and crossfader
Effects and performance pads for samples, hot cues, scratch and stems
Load demo tracks or upload your own audio
Record your mix and download it
Installable on your phone as an app
